note: The machine-readable form of the AI-native standard. AI-NATIVE.md states four scored axes, one human judgement, nine qualifications and a derived verdict in prose; nothing compiled them, so every claim that a surface is AI-native has so far been an opinion typed by whoever was writing. This table is the single statement the grader reads. It is a proposal: AI-NATIVE.md is a freeze candidate and the residual named in decisions/0070 is unruled, so a disagreement between this table and the document is a judgement item, not a licence to edit either.

reachability.asks: Can a fresh model instance discover the state, operations, inputs and result through a declared machine-usable path?

commitment.asks: Can the system distinguish a model's output from accepted enterprise state?

provenance.asks: Can a model-used or model-produced value resolve to where it came from?

retraction.asks: Can an AI-caused effective change be countered without erasing what happened?

earn_it.reviewer_note: AI-NATIVE.md calls this a human judgement with an attributable reviewer. The grader resolves the named reviewer against contracts/principals.json and refuses a judgement supplied by anything that is not a registered human principal, which is what stops a model scoring the check that decides whether its own surface earned the verdict.

same_world_parity.asks: Human and model interfaces resolve to the same transitions, constraints, standings and receipts.

typed_authority.asks: Permissions are scoped, revocable, attributable and checked at the operation; verification authority cannot ratify judgement.

independent_observation.asks: An executor's report is not the success oracle.

receipt_completeness.asks: Admission, refusal, operation, failure, observation and counteraction leave the required durable records.

effect_honesty.asks: Record retraction never masquerades as resource refund or external-world rollback.

cold_start_competence.asks: A fresh instance becomes safely useful from the artifact alone, with time and intervention measured.

two_binding_proof.asks: A human binding and a model binding pass the same positive and defeating fixtures against the same kernel contract.

local_sovereignty.asks: Loss of an integration cannot silently remove custody of authoritative memory, authority or continuity.

model_substitutability.asks: Two materially different models use the same named operation; identity, crossed data, usage and cost stay visible and an unavailable model refuses without silent fallback.

scenario_note: A qualification may be claimed PASS only on evidence that exists. A founding scenario at SEED standing is a narrative given/when/then that nothing executes, so citing one as the proof of a qualification is refused by SCENARIO_NOT_EXECUTABLE. Turning a seed into an executable case is what moves its qualification from UNPROVEN.

soveraeign_bar.note: AI-NATIVE.md requires FULL on reachability, commitment, provenance and the effect envelope admitted for the current phase. Retraction is that envelope axis, and its FULL definition is already phase-aware: it requires record state, consumed resources and external-world effects to be distinguished with compensation or refusal boundaries explicit. Phase I refuses external-world effects, so an explicit refusal boundary is how a Phase I surface reaches FULL; nothing here lowers the bar for the phase.

refusals.VERDICT_DECLARED: The record states a verdict. The verdict is derived from the recorded scores and is never selected directly (AI-NATIVE.md, Derived verdict).
refusals.EVIDENCE_ABSENT: A score above NONE, or a qualification claiming PASS, identifies no observable evidence.
refusals.SCENARIO_NOT_EXECUTABLE: The cited founding scenario is a seed narrative, so it evidences nothing yet.
refusals.SCENARIO_UNKNOWN: The cited founding scenario does not exist.
refusals.REVIEWER_NOT_HUMAN: The substantive-operation judgement names a reviewer that is not a registered human principal.
refusals.REVIEWER_UNREGISTERED: The substantive-operation judgement names a reviewer no principal registry knows.
refusals.QUALIFICATION_MISSING: The record does not answer every declared qualification.
refusals.CONTRADICTORY_SCORE: The record's own evidence contradicts the score it carries.
